entry.title: New: graphlint#integrations/dsh
entry.summary: Dead-code detection for AI-generated codebases: graphlint builds a dependency graph, finds code unreachable from any entry point to enable codebase cleanup and functional‑effectiveness understanding, and exposes graphlint_query / graphlint_build / graphlint_config tools plus a graphlint skill to DSH agents. Exact install spec: dsh-graphlint. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
